reviews.review_text:
APncs
Seattle, Washington21 contributions
0
Incompetent Staff - Son Got Sick (could have died) because of the Mis-Information
Oct 2017 • Family
Being American with a young son, I tend to go to cleaner and more expensive restaurants in VN because my son has severe allergies to nuts. 

I order the whole Peking Duck. I think it was around 950,000. Not cheap. I ask the first server's manager if there are any nuts in my order. He says no. My son takes a couple bites and instantly feels sick and his throat starts closing up. I ask again and another man assures me no nuts. My son says there is nuts 100% because he can feel it. So I call over the manager again and i tell him there has to be nuts because it's lunch time and my son hasn't eaten all day so there is something in the food with nuts. He keeps assuring me there is none. Then he leaves and goes to the kitchen (near the front of the restaurant with huge windows) All of the sudden I see like 8 cooks looking out the window staring at our table and looking at my son who is now in a lot of agonizing pain. I knew something was weird...then the manager comes to table and says there is just a little bit of peanuts in the sauce. HUH???? I asked 3 times!!!! Now u tell me!!! Then he tries to justify that it's a very small amount. 

I call over the GM and I tell him that my son is extremely allergic to nuts and now my son is sick after eating the duck. He instantly says...there's not nuts in the Peking Duck. Well, once again, WRONG ANSWER!!! He has doubts with me and goes to the kitchen and asks...and now realizes he gave the wrong answer and he ALSO tries to say...its a very small amount of nuts in the sauce. Apparently, they have no idea what allergies are. It doesn't matter what amount. If a kid is allergic...sometimes just sitting next to nuts can get them sick let alone take a couple bites!

To make it worse, we can't finish the duck because my son can't eat it and he is sick. They ask if there is something else they can get for him. But hes not feeling well so he doesn't want to eat. But I already gave him medicine and was prepared to give him the Epi Pen. The GM asks if some ginger and tea will help but said perhaps some 7 up will help with his upset stomach. So they bring him a can of 7 up.

The meal is kind of wasted because my son is sick so when the bill comes they told me they took off 25%. Personally, I don't think they should have charged anything. We didn't enjoy our meal, my son could have died had he continued to eat after they kept telling me there are no nuts. Clearly, we didn't finish our meal because there was so much leftover. And TO TOP IT OFF, they charged me 48,000 for a can of 7UP for a mistake they made! Keep in mind, a can of 7 up is like 10,000 outside. I wasn't even the mood to argue so i just paid the bill and called a cab to go home because he wasn't feeling good. Messed up our whole Sunday. Do they really think a 25% discount on the bill makes up for messing up a family's vacation? WOW. I will never come back here. Plenty of places that serve good Peking Duck. Start with the restaurant on Le Duan near the zoo. Much better service too.

Poor Service and Expensive
Feb 2017 • Solo
The window into the kitchen of Ngan Dinh Saigon Restaurant on Ding Khoi street catches your eye as you walk past. The ducks, chickens and tiny suckling pigs hanging in the window look very enticing (see photos). 
Unfortunately, once you are enticed inside, the ambience is hotel lobby, the service is disinterested and the food unexceptional, expensive and comes in modest servings.
The small sweet morsels brought at the end of your meal will appear on your bill as will the moist towels necessary to wipe your fingers. Tea is charged by the pot.
The wine selection is two whites and two reds. Of course, when you order the cheaper wine, it is so sad they have run out but you can have the more expensive (at the more expensive price of course).
Service feels like one of the old Government run tourist hotels where no one cares. Pity because the food really did look good from the street.
Even in this tourist district you can eat much better Chinese food more cheaply and with better service.
